structured.explanation: A mapping tool choice without a tool name (such as {} or {"type": "any"}) normalizes to a raw ToolChoice with name None and a copied mapping, and does not raise KeyError even when the registry is empty.
structured.test_code:
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import pytest

from llm_router import ToolChoice, ToolRegistry, normalize_tool_choice

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_TOOL_CHOICE[revision==2]")
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "choice",
    [{}, {"type": "any"}, {"type": "required"}],
    ids=["empty", "any", "required"],
)
def test_nameless_mapping_choice_normalizes_to_raw_without_name(
    choice: dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    registry = ToolRegistry(tools={})

    normalized = normalize_tool_choice(choice, registry=registry)

    assert normalized == ToolChoice(kind="raw", name=None, raw=choice)
    assert normalized.name is None
    assert normalized.raw == choice
    assert normalized.raw is not choice
